portfolio.name: Transport Management and Freight Exchange Portfolio

products.name: Enterprise TMS
products.description: Full-lifecycle transportation management for enterprise shippers: planning, carrier selection, transport orders, execution, visibility, costs, and analytics across plants, DCs, and countries.

products.name: Transport Execution
products.description: API-first execution product that wires a shipper's existing ERP, TMS, or planning system directly into the carrier network, orchestrating thousands of loads per day without a new planner UI.

products.name: Freight Procurement
products.description: Freight tendering and procurement suite for RFPs, RFQs, rate comparison, and capacity negotiation, turning yearly and spot tenders into signed rate cards and routing guides.

products.name: Freight Exchange
products.description: Pan-European spot freight marketplace matching posted loads with available truck capacity across a network of 80,000+ carriers in 80 countries, with trust scores and payment security built in.

products.name: Carrier Portal and Mobile App
products.description: The carrier-side workspace and driver app: accept and execute transport orders, capture e-documents and PODs, share live position, and manage exchange membership from the cab or the dispatch office.

products.name: Dock Scheduling
products.description: Slot booking and yard coordination for plants and DCs, smoothing dock utilization across the day and cutting truck waiting and turnaround times for sites and their carriers.

products.name: Network Analytics and Benchmarking
products.description: Data products built on network transaction flow: transport cost and service analytics, lane rate benchmarks, and CO2/CSRD emissions reporting for transportation leadership.
